Test Name: Open configuration panel from solution comparison
Description: Verify that clicking Configure Solution opens the configuration panel
Precondition: User is logged in as Engineering on /installation-system with at least one solution selected
Steps: 1. Navigate to /installation-system 2. Select solution "A210" 3. Click "Compare / Configure Solutions" 4. Click "Configure Solution"
Expected Result: Configuration panel opens with heading containing "Configure solution". Panel shows filter controls and option sections.

Test Name: Filter controls displayed in configure panel
Description: Verify filter controls are visible in the configuration panel
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Steps: 1. Observe the configuration panel filter section
Expected Result: Filters heading is visible. Fastener group select, Feeder tracks select, and filtered info text are visible.

Test Name: Machine options section displays option cards
Description: Verify the Machine section shows option cards with pricing
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Steps: 1. Observe the Machine section in the configuration panel
Expected Result: Machine section heading is visible. Option cards with names, prices, and part numbers are displayed.

Description: Verify the Options section shows accessory cards with pricing
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Steps: 1. Observe the Options section in the configuration panel
Expected Result: Options section heading is visible. Accessory cards are displayed.

Description: Verify the Custom Tooling section is visible
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Expected Result: Custom Tooling section heading and card are visible with $0.00 price.

Description: Verify the Configuration summary section with action buttons
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Expected Result: Configuration summary heading is visible. Download Quotation, Download Word, Add Manual Line Item, and Request Quotation buttons are visible.

Test Name: Select a machine option updates total
Description: Verify selecting an option updates the total price
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Steps: 1. Click "Add to configuration" on a machine option (e.g. Changeover set) 2. Observe Configuration summary
Expected Result: The option appears in the summary. Selected options total updates to reflect the added option price (e.g. $615.00).

Test Name: Select multiple options updates total cumulatively
Precondition: Configuration panel is open for solution A210
Steps: 1. Add a machine option 2. Add an Options section item (e.g. Process monitoring)
Expected Result: Both options appear in summary. Total reflects sum of both prices.

Test Name: All 4 roles can open configuration panel
Description: Verify all roles can access the machine configuration panel

Steps: 1. Log in as role 2. Navigate to /installation-system 3. Select solution "A210" 4. Click "Compare / Configure Solutions" 5. Click "Configure Solution"
Expected Result: All 4 roles can successfully open the configuration panel with options visible.

Description: Verify fastener group filter changes available options

Test Name: Open configuration for a different solution
Description: Verify different solutions show different options
Precondition: Two solutions are selected (A210 and 824 eDrive)
